description: This file defines the 'PaypalPaymentMethod' class, which implements PayPal payment processing via the Omnipay library in the Goteo project. It includes methods for initiating and completing PayPal transactions.

classes.name: PaypalPaymentMethod
classes.description: A class implementing PayPal Express payment method for Goteo, providing purchase and completion processes.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the name of the payment gateway, 'PayPal_Express'.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Initiates a PayPal purchase transaction with configured parameters and returns the response.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes a PayPal transaction after user authorization and returns the response.

methods.name: getGatewayName
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the PayPal gateway.

methods.name: purchase
methods.description: Sets up and sends a purchase request to PayPal using the Omnipay gateway.

methods.name: completePurchase
methods.description: Completes a purchase by finalizing the transaction with PayPal.
